exposure: preoperative placenta accreta spectrum ultrasound scoring system (PASUSS) score
cohort: The study included 450 patients with anterior placenta previa combined with previous cesarean section who delivered at Shengjing Hospital affiliated with China Medical University between January 2018 and March 2022.
finding: Preoperative systemic immune-inflammatory index, preoperative D-dimer level, preoperative PASUSS score, and one-step-conservative surgery were identified as independent risk factors for severe postpartum hemorrhage in the studied population.
